statement.zh: Samaniego 等（1985）公布塞钦山中心建筑、石雕与彩绘，并据地层与测年修订年代。
statement.en: Samaniego et al. (1985) publish Cerro Sechín central architecture, carvings, and paintings, revising chronology from strata and dates.
